notes.title: Sneak Peek Hotfix
notes.content:
Hey everyone!,

We are happy to announce that as promised, the latest hotfix is now live! Here’s what you can expect from this update:

[list]
[*] General polishing and bug fixing to enhance overall gameplay stability.
[*] Added clarification and visual effects to the edging minigame, making it more intuitive and engaging.
[*] Added a tutorial for the edging minigame, helping you master it quickly and effectively.
[*] Improved UI looks and usability, providing a smoother and more user-friendly experience.
[*] Fixes to characters, animations, and apparel, ensuring a more seamless visual experience.
[*] Adjustments to the Mirror of Desire level design and materials for better playability.
[*] User Settings now load and apply correctly, addressing previous issues.
[*] Fixed controls for different audio settings, giving you better control over your gaming experience.
[/list]

Thank you for your continued support and stay kinky!

Stay Kinky! Tell us what you think!

notes.title: Development Update
notes.content:
[b]Hey everyone![/b]

If you have been following, you probably notices we had a slight delay with the development of the game, due to the problematic release of our other game "Slaves of Rome", which needed "all hands on deck" for the past month. However, we are happy to say that it seems things are a bit more stable now and that allows us to resume development of My Lust Wish while Rome is still being built and fixed by the rest of the team!

We already have a few big changes coming up in the next build:

[list]
[*] We are currently prototyping big changes to the sex system including a director mode that allows you to create and play your own scenes. In addition we are experimenting with a new minigame for climaxing, as well as different camera angles and controls.
[*] Mirror of Desire is a level that will allow you to play around with the new sex system and customization options until we rework the story mode.
[*] The quests and general progression of the story mode are also going through changes and some nice plans are already being set up. Implementation will begin shortly once we feel that the changes offer a better experience for players that are looking to explore the world of BDSM as Ashley.
[/list]

We will try to post sneak peaks for these updates very soon and hopefully post a build in about 6-8 weeks.
Stay kinky!

notes.title: HOTFIX: Major Release Bugs Fix
notes.content:
We received your feedback that the release seemed to have some serious bugs which we didn't notice - this was mostly caused by the difference in Versions between Patreon and Steam versions and how the saving systems works. We are sorry about that and hope this quick hotfix at least addresses the major issues, as we tried to do this as fast as possible. Of course, we will keep fixing more and more over the next days, weeks and months :). Here is a list of what should have been fixed in this update - would be happy to hear your feedback of course and if you encounter something major!


************************************************************************************
-Fixed an issue where the dialogue on the bus stop would not unload.
-Fixed an issue where some dialogue trigger boxes would load again after loading a saved game.
-Fixed an issue where the items inside a storage would be refreshed after loading a saved game.
-Fixed an issue where the saved games would get corrupted.
    It is highly recommended to clear old save game data.
-Improved the handling of saved games and their related files.
-Fixed an issue where the sequences where not unloading properly at the Janitor Job.
************************************************************************************

PLEASE NOTICE: IN ORDER TO WORK, YOU MIGHT NEED TO DELETE YOUR OLD SAVE (IF YOU HAVE AN OLD SAVE) FROM OLD (MOSTLY, NON-STEAM VERSIONS YOU MIGHT HAVE HAD BEFORE)


And now.. we are going to sleep since we haven't for like 48 hours ːsteamhappyː
